events.caption: Push blue back from its current position for the second collision.
Push red from its new position for the third collision and upward kick.

setup: One continuous run: push red, send blue back, then push red from where the second collision leaves it. No objects are repositioned.
name: Third-contact jump

oracle.name: Third-contact jump
oracle.law: Every third separate contact between red and blue sets both upward velocities to 4. Sustained contact counts once. Only this pair counts, based on object identity, not current color.
oracle.plain: Every third collision between the two balls makes both jump.
oracle.plain_zh: 两球每相撞三次，就一起向上跳一下。
oracle.condition: The original red–blue pair makes its third distinct contact.
oracle.effect: Both receive an upward kick. The count then continues to the next third contact.
oracle.scope: Sustained contact counts once. Wall, floor and added-ball contacts do not increment this counter.

reference: Identical initial preparation and impulses, with the altered program disabled.
